name: Portal UI — connection creation
summary: Foundry portal supports creating BYOM connections, but only for v2 APIM resources fronting OpenAI-compatible chat completions APIs.
description: Per Operate → Admin console → Admin-connected models → Add: 'Azure API Management' connection type requires a v2 APIM resource and a model implementing the OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. ModelGateway connections and non-OpenAI providers (Anthropic, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, DeepSeek) are not creatable through the portal — use the Bicep templates in microsoft-foundry/foundry-samples for those.
notes: Status-only. The 'Other source' option in the wizard covers self-hosted/non-Azure OpenAI-compatible gateways but still requires an OpenAI-compatible chat completions surface.
